seo.title: TDEE Calculator (2026) – Maintenance Calories
seo.description: Calculate your TDEE (maintenance calories), plus cutting and bulking targets. Includes a shareable result card and PNG download.

ui.hero_lead: Get your maintenance calories, then see cut and bulk targets. Fast, clean, shareable.

faq.a: TDEE is your total daily energy expenditure—roughly the calories you burn per day including activity.

faq.q: How accurate is a TDEE calculator?
faq.a: It’s an estimate. Use it as a starting point and adjust based on 2–3 weeks of weight trend.
